page.layout: One printed page, single column of dictionary entries; running head "LU." centred at top; page number 421 at top right; signature "Dd 3" centred at foot; catchword "Lux]" at lower right. Faint show-through from the reverse page appears in the margins and is not transcribed.

main_text.p: Luna crescens] Luna crescens gibbosa, Firm. Cornicula, Apul. Major dimidiata, Martian. Capel.
Luna decrescens] Luna extrema senescens, Varr. Luna deficiens, Plin. Luna minuens, Pallad. Senium lunæ, Plin. Decrescentia lunæ, Vitr.
Lupanar] Stabulum, Plaut. Ganeum, Ter. Meritorium, Firm. Fornix, Iuven. Lustrum, Cic. Ianua orci, Plaut.
Luscinia] Lusciniola, Plaut. Philomela. Aedon, Virg. Acredula, Cic. Isid. Attis, Mart.
Lusciosus] Lolio victitat, Plaut. Male oculatus, Suet. Male luminatus, Apul. Nyctalops, Plin. Myops, Bud. Caeculus, Ser. Microspicus.
Luscus] Cocles, Plin. Unoculus, Plaut. Monoculus, Firm. Defioculus, Mart. Oculum persolum habet. Catapulta alter oculus ictus est, Plaut.
Lusoria pugna] Pugnant volsellis non gladiis.
Lusorius] Ludicer. Ludicrus, Gell. Ludiae coronae, Plin.
Lustrare] Perlustrare oculis. Prospeculari, Liv. Circumspicere. Contemplari, Cic. Visere, Plaut. Convisere oculis, Lucr. Oculis obire, Plin. Perspectare, Plaut. Vid. transl. Expiare.
Lustricus] Expiabilis, Cic. Piacularis, Liv. Piaculus porcus, Cic. Lustralis aqua, Ovid. Lustrificus, Val. Arg. Purgatoriae virtutes, Macrob.
Lutare] Lutulare, Plaut. Collutulare aliquem, Limare caput limo, Id. Lambin. Vestimenta elevit luto, Non.
Luteus de colore] Luteola viola, Col. Silaceus color. Calthulus, Melleus, Plin. Fulvum aurum. Flavus crinis, Virg. Floridi crines, Id. Serv. Col. Galbus, & Galbeus, Lævin.
Lutosus] Limosus, Virg. Lutulentus, Ovid. Lutensis. Luto nutritus. Dialutensis purpura, Plin. Labosum & lutosum iter, Lucil. Luto lutulentior, Er.
Lutum] Coenum. Limus, Virg. Volutabrum porcorum, Lux]
